none: PAS FindID 971919: Roman Coin: Sestertius of Faustina II, issued under Marcus Aurelius
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Sestertius of Faustina II (147-175), as kindly identified by the finder, RIC. Vol. 3 page 345 no. 1635, mint of Rome, listed as issue of Marcus Aurelius c. 179.. Obverse description: Bust coiffed with bun draped right. Obverse inscription: FAVSTINA AVGVSTA. Reverse description: Draped female figure [Fecunditas] standing left holding small child, flanked by two small children. Reverse inscription: [FE]CVND AVG[VSTAE]. Diameter: 31.7mm, Weight: 22.69gms, die axis: 12
